note: Fictional group. No real organisation, person or incident is described. Evidence status is derived from a hash of the system and artefact id against that system's maturity value, so the portfolio is reproducible but carries no real-world meaning.

incidents.title: Screening model down-ranked candidates with employment gaps
incidents.detail: A recruiter escalation, not a monitoring alert, surfaced the pattern. The correlation with parental leave was found on review of 90 days of decision logs.

incidents.title: Retrieval returned another customer's order data in a chat reply
incidents.root_cause: Tenant filter missing on a retrieval index
incidents.detail: Guardrails caught none of it; a customer reported the disclosure. Index rebuilt with tenant scoping and a regression test added.

incidents.title: Limit-setting model drifted beyond declared accuracy band
incidents.root_cause: Population shift after a new market launch
incidents.detail: Drift was visible in vendor telemetry for six weeks before anyone reviewed it. No internal monitoring threshold existed.

incidents.title: Emotion analytics used in live interviews before legal sign-off
incidents.root_cause: Vendor feature enabled by default after an upgrade
incidents.detail: A prohibited practice ran for eleven days. Feature disabled, data deleted, works council and DPO notified, deployment now in decommissioning.

incidents.title: Carrier blocked by fraud score with no contestation route
incidents.root_cause: Score reused as an onboarding gate without a review step
incidents.detail: A legitimate haulier lost nine days of loads. The detection model had been wired into an access decision, which is the reuse that lifts the tier.

incidents.title: Synthetic spokesperson audio published without marking
incidents.root_cause: No provenance metadata in the publishing pipeline
incidents.detail: Two regional radio spots went out unmarked. Pulled and re-cut; marking check added to the publishing gate.
